_readme: FILE 1 of 2 — 'JSON I SEND TO AI'. This is the EXACT request payload this backend builds and POSTs to the AI provider (OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions). Built by src/modules/ai/architect.service.ts (analysis) and src/modules/ai/chat.service.ts (chat). Sent via src/infrastructure/llm/llm.client.ts using fetch().

aiProviderConfig._note: Values come from Backend/.env — put YOUR API KEY there. Never hardcode the key here.

useCase_1_analyzeGitHubRepo._note: Triggered by POST /api/v1/projects/:id/analyze after the GitHub MERN repo is cloned & parsed. temperature=0.15.

messages.content: You are a senior software architect... [ARCHITECT_SYSTEM_PROMPT from ai.prompts.ts] ... Reply with ONLY valid JSON having 'components' and 'connections' (4-25 components, stable kebab-case ids).

Analyze this codebase summary and produce the architecture JSON.

{"project":{"name":"node-express-mongoose-boilerplate","language":"JavaScript"},"stats":{"filesConsidered":60,"totalRoutes":25,"totalModels":6},"dependencies":["express","mongoose","jsonwebtoken","bcryptjs","express-validator","passport"],"routes":[{"method":"POST","path":"/auth/register","handler":"authController.register","file":"src/routes/auth.routes.ts"},{"method":"POST","path":"/users/me","handler":"userController.updateMe","file":"src/routes/user.routes.ts"}],"models":[{"name":"User","fields":["email","password","name","role"],"file":"src/models/user.model.ts"}],"controllers":[{"name":"authController","file":"src/controllers/auth.controller.ts"}],"services":[{"name":"emailService","file":"src/services/email.service.ts"}],"authIndicators":{"jwtLibraryUsed":true,"passwordHashingUsed":true,"evidence":["jwt used in src/services/token.service.ts"]},"filesByRole":{"route":8,"controller":6,"model":6,"service":4,"entry":1},"sampleImports":["import mongoose from 'mongoose'"]}

retryOnBadShape._note: If AI output fails schema validation, one retry is sent with temperature=0 adding:

extraMessages.content: Your previous reply was not valid per the schema. Reply again with ONLY the JSON object having "components" and "connections".

useCase_2_chatQuestion._note: Triggered by POST /api/v1/projects/:id/chat. temperature=0.3. Architecture ids come from the stored analysis.

messages.content:
You are Software World Guide... Answer in 2-5 short sentences then final lines EXACTLY:
TARGET_COMPONENT: <component-id-or-NONE>
PATH: <comma-separated component ids or NONE>

expectedAiReplyShape._seeAlso: See FILE 2 (AI_RESPONSE_TO_FRONTEND.json) for how this reply is validated and forwarded to the frontend.
